record.description: AWeber is a prominent email marketing service provider based in Chalfont, PA, serving over 100,000 small businesses, bloggers, and entrepreneurs globally. Since its establishment in 1998 by Tom Kulzer, AWeber has focused on empowering businesses with web-based tools to enhance customer communication and engagement through email campaigns. The company's mission is to develop innovative solutions that support their customers' growth, guided by core values that foster creativity and problem-solving within the team. AWeber has received multiple accolades for its workplace culture and customer service excellence.
